Navigation test fixture

Host this page over HTTPS, build an app with its URL as the start URL (defaults), then tap each item.
Current host: . Set the query string ?other=https://example.org to change the "other host".

  • 1. Same host, same page path Open page2.html Expected: opens in the app.
  • 2. Different host Open example.org Expected: blocked (toast), stays here.
  • 3. Lookalike host Open <this-host>.attacker.test Expected: blocked.
  • 4. Plain HTTP, same host Open http://<this-host>/ Expected: blocked (not HTTPS).
  • 5. Redirect to another host Open /redirect-out (302 to example.org) Expected: the final off-host page is not displayed; a blocked page or toast appears.
  • 6. Same-host redirect Open /redirect-same (302 to page2.html) Expected: opens page2.html in the app.
  • 7. target="_blank" Same-host link, new window | Other-host link, new window Expected: nothing opens (popups are suppressed).
  • 8. window.open() Expected: nothing opens.
  • 9. JavaScript navigation to another host Expected: blocked.
  • 10. JavaScript navigation on the same host Expected: opens page2.html.
  • 11. SPA-style navigation Expected: URL changes, page stays; no blocking.
  • 12. Form POST to the same host
    Expected: shows the echo page.
  • 13. Form POST to another host (known limitation)
    shouldOverrideUrlLoading is never called for POST. The generated app additionally checks main-frame requests in shouldInterceptRequest and shows a "Link blocked" page, but this is best effort, not a security boundary.
  • 14. Non-web schemes intent: | market: | mailto: | javascript: Expected: blocked / ignored; no other app is launched.
  • 15. Subframe from another host Policy applies to top-level navigation only; subresources and frames are not filtered.
